title: Mother Dearest

sources.title: Summon Golem Bell
markers: | description = '''Summon Golem Bell''' is a miscellaneous item which is only functional in the [[Gauntlet of Shar]]. While in combat there, it can be used to summon the construct {{CharLink|Flesh}}.

summary: Keep this bottled eye in inventory to unlock additional dialogue with Balthazar.

fields.Trigger: Persuade Balthazar to offer the Summon Golem Bell, then ask about his mother before taking it. Loot Mother Dearest from the nearby shelf and speak to him again.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
